crossRefs.note: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,

translations.web: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.
translations.bsb: But only on this condition will the men agree to dwell with us and be one people: if all our men are circumcised as they are.
translations.kjv: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
translations.asv: Only on this condition will the men consent unto us to dwell with us, to become one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
